questions.question: What does each node use to estimate the shortest path to a destination?

answers.b: Routing table of the entire network
answers.d: MAC addresses of all network devices

questions.question: What is the main challenge of the Distance Vector Algorithm?
What triggers a node to send its updated distance vector to neighbors?

answers.b: It receives an updated distance vector from a neighbor and its own vector changes
answers.c: It receives a data packet from another node
answers.d: A new device connects to the network

questions.question: What mechanism helps reduce the Count-to-Infinity problem?
How does a node decide which neighbor to use for forwarding packets?

answers.a: It selects the neighbor with the lowest cost in its distance vector
answers.c: It forwards packets to all neighbors
answers.d: It always forwards packets to the central router
